title: Fix Windows GNU release bundling and bundle WebView2Loader.dll in portable and NSIS artifacts
commitMessage: feat(build): fix Windows GNU release bundling and include WebView2Loader.dll in portable and NSIS artifacts
author: tauri-rust-engineer (Level 1)
summary: Diagnosed and resolved release build and bundling failure on Windows under x86_64-pc-windows-gnu toolchain (llvm-mingw). Fixed runtime 'WebView2Loader.dll not found' error by copying the target WebView2Loader.dll into Release/Windows/bin/ alongside canban-voimax-harness.exe, and created src-tauri/nsis-hooks.nsh to embed WebView2Loader.dll into the NSIS installer. Pruned bundle targets in tauri.conf.json to ['nsis'] to eliminate WiX v3 stalls, and hardened build-release.ps1 and build-release.bat with automatic toolchain discovery, short temp directory redirect, and multi-candidate artifact collection.
